resources.string: Goals seekhein
Kuch steps mein Goals seekhein
Sample goals ke saath chhoti guide dekhein. Aapke asli goals nahi badlenge.
Practice mode · Sample goals
Practice se pehle current goal form ya action close karein aur saving finish hone dein.
Ek chapter revise karein
Notes padhein aur examples revise karein.
Do sections revise karein
Aap kya seekhna chahte hain?
Goal kaise banayein aur poora karein
Goal ki planning karein ya repeat karein
Routine repeat karein
Goal badlein ya wapas laayein
Missed goals handle karein
Apni progress dekhein
Goal add karein
Add goal chunein.
Ek clear study task se shuru karein. Next sample form kholta hai; real goal create nahi hota.
Naam dekar goal banayein
Kaam ka naam likhein, phir Create Goal chunein.
Ek clear kaam likhein. Details, future date aur daily repeat optional hain. Next se sample goal Today mein dikhega.
Goal create karein
Ready hone par Create goal chunein.
Future date na chunein toh naya goal Today mein aata hai. Next sample goal Today mein dikhayega.
Aaj ka goal karein
Today mein apna task dekhein.
Today mein abhi karne wale goals dikhte hain. Study shuru karne se pehle title aur details dekhein.
Goal poora hone par tick karein
Today mein goal dhoondhein aur uska checkbox dabayein.
Kaam poora hone par checkbox dabayein. Isse study time aur completion ke options khulte hain.
Study time record karein
Time bharein ya quick-add chunein.
Hours aur minutes manual study time record karte hain. Bina time add kiye bhi complete kar sakte hain. Ekagra mein recorded time dobara na jodein.
Time jodein aur finish karein
Zarurat ho to time jodein, phir Done dabayein.
Hours, minutes ya quick-add buttons use karein. Done se time save hokar goal poora hota hai. Complete without study time se minutes nahi judte. Ekagra mein recorded time dobara na jodein.
Completed goals dekhein
Apna kaam dekhne ke liye History kholein.
History completed goals ko assigned day ke hisaab se dikhati hai. Date choose karke us din ka kaam dekhein. Sample exit par hat jayega.
Aage plan karein
Future day schedule karna enable karein.
Goals default Today ke liye hote hain. Baad mein karna ho toh future-day option chunein.
Aane wala din chunein
Schedule chalu karein aur date chunein.
Future date wala option chunein aur din tay karein. Taiyar hone par goal banayein. Is sample mein kal ki date hai.
Scheduled kaam dekhein
Upcoming mein future goals dekhein.
Assigned day se pehle scheduled goal Upcoming mein dikhta hai. Us din woh Today mein available hota hai.
Daily routine banayein
Zaroorat par Repeat every day enable karein.
Recurring work ke liye daily repeat use karein. Ek din ka goal complete karna sab future days complete nahi karta.
Apne tasks repeat karein
Chune hue tasks repeat karne ke liye Repeat Goals kholein.
Upar ke buttons se Repeat Goals kholein. Aaj ke tasks kal ke liye ya kal ke tasks aaj ke liye chunein. Automatic repeat se daily routine banti hai.
Selected kaam daily repeat karein
Routine ke liye automatic repeat use karein.
Aaj ke goals kal repeat karte waqt automatic-repeat se selected tasks daily routine ban jaate hain.
Kal ka kaam aaj laayein
Repeat Goals mein Yesterday chunein.
Yesterday se kal ke tasks aaj ke liye select karein. Next sirf sample view badalta hai; real goals duplicate nahi hote.
Goal manage karein
Goal ka three-dot menu kholein.
Open goal menu mein edit, complete aur delete actions milte hain. Available action se completed goal reopen kar sakte hain.
Plan adjust karein
Title ya details edit karke save karein.
Open goal ke Edit se task, schedule ya daily repeat update karein. Practice same form mein sample title use karti hai.
Deleted goal recover karein
Recently deleted mein Restore chunein.
Delete se pehle confirmation hota hai aur 30 days tak recover kar sakte hain. Restore goal ko uski date par laata hai; purana goal missed ho sakta hai.
Chhoote hue tasks sambhalein
Purane tasks finish karne ya date badalne ke liye Missed kholein.
Missed mein purane dinon ke adhure goals hain. Unhein finish karein ya date badlein. Finish karte waqt purana din rakh sakte hain ya aaj par la sakte hain.
Completion date chunein
Original date rakhein ya Today par laayein.
Older goal ka time enter karne ke baad original day ke liye complete karein ya today move karke complete karein. Cancel goal open rakhta hai.
Progress check karein
Quick overview ke liye Status kholein.
Status open, missed, scheduled aur completed goals summarize karta hai. Practice ke numbers sample data hain.
Apne trends dekhein
Goal analytics ke liye Insights use karein.
Normal use mein Insights Goals analytics kholta hai. Tutorial sirf entry highlight karta hai; account data load nahi hota.
Focus aur goals connect karein
Ekagra session save karte waqt goal link karein.
Ekagra save flow mein goal select karke open rakhein ya done mark karein. Completion ke baad Goals History linked focus contributions dikhati hai. Wahi minutes dobara manual na jodein.
